THIS IS AN INDEX, NOT A SOURCE OF NUMBERS. OCR misreads exactly the characters that matter
on a drawing: a decimal point, a tolerance, an H7, a 6 against an 8. Use this to find WHICH
drawing to open. Then open it:  pdftoppm -r 300 -png -f <page> -l <page> v2/vendor/switches/apem-switch-guards-series.pdf
